fonts.heading: Sora (700/800) — headlines, numbers, buttons only
fonts.rule: two fonts max, never mix a third

notes: Section order/components replicate metechstudio.com's homepage (hero, pain points, services, process, tools strip, geo reach, problem/solution, benefits, FAQ) adapted to a solo consultant instead of a multi-department agency (dropped their per-industry grid). All copy/projects/facts are Ghazan's own, sourced from his CV and existing site content — nothing copied from the reference. Hero uses a GSAP 3D-perspective card stack (mouse parallax + scroll-driven depth/rotation) rather than a WebGL 3D scene, per the owner's confirmed intent (GSAP-based 'feels 3D', not literal 3D models).
